content.title: Pursuit Route Reframe | False Escape, Collapse and Remote Survival
content.summary: Bind one adult protagonist to a clear carrier escape, let boarding create a brief false resolution, then irreversibly remove that route while withholding the adult's status. Reintroduce the same identity at a remote safe vantage so survival spatially reframes the pursuit.

quick_start.input_format: clearly adult original protagonist, approaching group and one visible escape carrier share a readable departure geography + pursuit direction stays continuous until carrier boarding + boarding holds briefly as a false resolution + one irreversible event removes the route while occlusion withholds protagonist status + the same adult reappears at a remote safe vantage with at least three identity anchors and a held look back
quick_start.recommended_input: An adult polar courier with a slate coat, orange shoulder beacon and white data case boards the final hover ferry; one ice-shelf collapse destroys the pier, then the same courier appears on a distant lighthouse balcony and looks back across the broken route.
required_anchors: Open with one clearly adult original protagonist, one approaching group and one visible escape carrier in a readable departure geography.
Keep pursuit direction continuous until the protagonist boards the carrier.
Use exactly one irreversible event to remove the route while withholding the protagonist's state.
Reintroduce the same adult at a separate safe vantage with three identity anchors and one held look back.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Bind one adult protagonist to a clear carrier escape, let boarding create a brief false resolution, then irreversibly remove that route while withholding the adult's status. Reintroduce the same identity at a remote safe vantage so survival spatially reframes the pursuit.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one original clearly adult protagonist alone at a legible departure node, one approaching group and one apparently decisive escape carrier. Use a continuous directional chase to bind the adult's objective to boarding that carrier, then give boarding a brief readable false-resolution hold. Destroy or permanently disable only the apparent route in one visually decisive event while withholding the protagonist's state through smoke, occlusion or a clean temporal cut. Reintroduce the same adult at a geographically separate safe vantage with at least three identity anchors intact, and hold a deliberate look back toward the former route or camera long enough to prove survival. The reusable mechanism is isolation, closing pursuit, carrier-bound false escape, irreversible route collapse, withheld status and remote survivor reframe—not the source woman, face, wet hair, clothing, subway, station, pursuers, explosion, city roof, exact shots, title text, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Open with one clearly adult original protagonist, one approaching group and one visible escape carrier in a readable departure geography.
invariants.purpose: Creates a single apparent objective and pressure vector.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without all three anchors, later boarding and route loss have no causal meaning.

invariants.rule: Keep pursuit direction continuous until the protagonist boards the carrier.
invariants.purpose: Lets distance and access function as a progress clock.
invariants.ablation_failure: Direction reversals or unrelated cuts make the chase geography incoherent.

invariants.rule: Hold successful boarding briefly as a false resolution before any destruction.
invariants.purpose: Gives the audience a concrete state to lose.
invariants.ablation_failure: Immediate destruction reads as undifferentiated action rather than reversal.

invariants.rule: Use exactly one irreversible event to remove the route while withholding the protagonist's state.
invariants.purpose: Creates a clean information gap without repetitive spectacle.
invariants.ablation_failure: Showing the protagonist safe during the event eliminates the reframe.

invariants.rule: Reintroduce the same adult at a separate safe vantage with three identity anchors and one held look back.
invariants.purpose: Proves survival and spatial separation while inviting reinterpretation.
invariants.ablation_failure: A new identity or fleeting insert looks like a continuity error rather than a reveal.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source adult woman, face, wet dark hair, burgundy-black clothing and exact expressions
the source dark-clad pursuers, bodies, spacing, costumes and exact chase choreography
the source subway station, yellow platform line, silver train, carriage and red tunnel
the source fireball, sparks, debris, city rooftop, exact camera order and composition
the source creator identity, Seedance 2.5 wording, end-card text and 30-second timing
